name: status-band
description: Draws a one-line status band above the prompt from any command that prints JSON, plus a live count of this session's subagents. /band prints the detail.

command.title: Feed command
command.description: The command to run, one argument per entry, no shell. It must print JSON: {"title", "segments": [{"label", "value", "alert"}], "detail"}.

interval_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
interval_seconds.description: How often to rerun the feed command
